title: The Resilience of Value Investing
text: value lost money in 42% of years even before the slump that we're talking about starting from 07. So the best year was in 2000 which was up 45%. The worst year was 2020 down 31%. So this still can be a very valid risk premium. Just because it loses money over certain durations doesn't really mean anything. That happens. So if we analyze claim one that cheap beats expensive over a century, it does. It objectively does. Simply because it has changed recently does not mean that it doesn't in the long run. Now the question is is it still there which is something that we'll take a look at.
